freeze_scope: Fixed before any complete controlled 18-cell PDMS comparison; core training was already in progress. Historical ladder scores and one ineligible 3-scene smoke score were already known.

case_selection.effect: Mean of three paired per-seed scene PDMS differences, never a trajectory ensemble
case_selection.rank: ascending SHA256(salt|split|contrast|bin|token), with token as tie-breaker
case_selection.shortfall: Report candidate/selected counts and empty bins; never relax effect thresholds or the session restriction
case_selection.disclosure: Outcome-conditioned diagnostic cases, not representative prevalence estimates or independent confirmation; intermediate-effect scenes are not in these three bins

plot.trajectories: Display all three seeds individually with fixed seed 0 emphasized; no best-seed selection
plot.coordinates: Current ego frame, metres; reference centerline is not a drivable-area boundary
plot.objects: Display privileged current boxes; show donor boxes separately for shuffled conditions
plot.expert: Logged future ego trajectory is evaluation-only and was not a model input
plot.simulation: Plans and current inputs only, not a rendering of the official simulated ego rollout or collision determination
